species.name: Trout
why: Water 50°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 26–40 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 50 ft, cold below.

species.name: Kokanee
